name: deferred-full-substrate
principle: Everything from substrate_design_it.md that is NOT required for durability-now. Deferred without prejudice: the full programme remains canon (rev12, FROZEN architecturally) and the minimal kernel items cite back into it so absorption later is semantic-preserving.

deferred_items.name: Stage 0 kernel: daemon + state.db + socket
deferred_items.content: Single SQLite(WAL) ~/.xtrm/state.db served by xt daemon over Unix socket; lazy launch + file lock + PID-aware cleanup; all domain packages as StateClient socket clients; project registration.
deferred_items.deferral_reason: Premortem R1: Stage 0 is the hardest product in the system and gates everything; premortem plan-revision row 9 (cut Stage 0 scope) remains owned by state-store-options/monorepo-migration.

deferred_items.name: Monorepo packaging (core/substrate/channels/specialists/console)
deferred_items.content: Five npm packages, acyclic deps, ownership-in-code of table schemas, no cross-domain FK.
deferred_items.canonical_source: substrate_design_it.md §0 package table; owned by monorepo-migration doc
deferred_items.deferral_reason: structural migration; no durability value before Stage 0

deferred_items.name: Seed planning container
deferred_items.content: seed kind: advisor channel, invite rules, plan.v1 artifact, approval modes auto/operator-gate/re-seed, transform-on-approval commit.
deferred_items.deferral_reason: depends on container entity + channels v0 + validator (stages 1/2/4/5)

deferred_items.name: Epic / wave / node container kinds
deferred_items.content: DAG epic with shared integration base; parallel wave with independent bases; standing autonomous node with autonomy policy, failure budget, scheduling authority limits, Stage 4.5 delivery demo gate.
deferred_items.deferral_reason: node coordinator is premortem R5 load-bearing-fiction risk until its executable demo exists (Stage 4.5)

deferred_items.name: Chain-template engine and composition moments
deferred_items.content: Two-layer templates (domain steps + mandatory gates), three composition moments, composition gate review/insert/approve, worktree lease, two-axis git model, mid-run insertion, promotion cycle, eight archetypes + fifteen-formula catalog (catalog semantics owned by chain_templates.md).
deferred_items.deferral_reason: requires container entity + issue store (stages 1/4); template catalog already operates pre-substrate via bd formulas

deferred_items.name: New issue system (schema, classifiers, relationships, close-as-derivation)
deferred_items.content: Structured contracts (change/step, XML), class/type/role axes, nine relationship kinds with gating classes, two-stage validator + third entry-gate moment, close_ready→merge transactional close.
deferred_items.deferral_reason: replaces bd; bd remains the issue store through the adoption period (temp_roadmap keeper-class framing)

deferred_items.name: Collision matrix
deferred_items.content: Per-worktree diff polling, file/range/semantic severity tiers, serialize/unify/pause/reconcile resolution commands.

deferred_items.name: Pulse/emitter infrastructure
deferred_items.content: triggers/pulse_queue/pulse_dedup tables, emitter registration, capability model can_emit, node FIFO queues with mechanical rate-limit/coalescing.
deferred_items.deferral_reason: daemon-dependent; MDK-4 carries forward only the idempotency-key pattern

deferred_items.name: Memory subsystem formalization
deferred_items.content: memories table with type classifier, herd/workgroup/identity query lenses, memory-query extension injection, close-time distillation by closing judge.
deferred_items.deferral_reason: current bd memories + service-knowledge cover the need; open tuning questions (pruning/promotion predicates) explicitly deferred by canon

deferred_items.name: Skills-as-capability per-step injection
deferred_items.content: skill packs injected at composition or coordinator entry-gate via step.required_skills; sublayer to service-skills; generic template + per-repo override precedence.
deferred_items.deferral_reason: dispatcher contract field requires chain composition to exist

deferred_items.name: Coordinator roles (node + chain, five roles)
deferred_items.content: Node coordinator (stateless, journal respawn, failure budget) and chain coordinator (entry gate verdict:ready, borderline judge, hygiene pulse, close-time judge with atomic coordinator.release, incident handler).
deferred_items.deferral_reason: judgment layer over containers/channels; xtrm-1jp vocabulary preserved in Lane E contract so semantics are not lost

deferred_items.name: Tether, dashboard/console, API faces
deferred_items.content: Always-on hint sidecar; console renderer + lineage drawer (owned by console-product-contract); three-face API (query/change-tracking/command) with monotonic cursor and read-live bias.
deferred_items.deferral_reason: consumer surfaces over deferred state; premortem R8 risk recorded (substrate invisible without them — acceptance criterion when stages resume)

deferred_items.name: Two-tier deployment projection (Supabase top tier)
deferred_items.content: Optional shared/web tier: auth, realtime, team-level writes as read-mostly projection upward via opaque-ID row transfer.
deferred_items.deferral_reason: explicitly tier-gated (team/company); solo-user horizon does not need it; premortem R7 top-tier-v0 criterion is a Stage 0 acceptance item whenever Stage 0 resumes

deferred_items.name: bd → substrate data migration (Stage 13)
deferred_items.content: One-time data migration replacing bd; §13.8 bridge whitelist (bd mirror, shadow write, GitHub materializer compat) with measurable retirement criteria and per-Stage rollback gates.
deferred_items.deferral_reason: last stage; bd stays authoritative throughout adoption period

R9 independent-reviewer gate for rev13+ sections (forensic design.review evidence required)
Still-real risks ranked in synthesis.md: canon drift > migration gates > author=implementer
